title: The heart is cardiac muscle that pumps blood without a conscious command
summary: The heart is cardiac muscle that pumps blood through the body without a person deciding each beat, NIAMS says.
body: NIAMS says cardiac muscle makes up the heart. It contracts and relaxes on its own to pump blood through the body. A person does not need to think about telling it to beat. This card is that plain account. A chamber diagram sits on another card.

sources.title: Health Lesson: Learning About Muscles
sources.author: National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases
sources.note: US government page, public domain. Last Updated June 2025. Cardiac muscles section: they make up the heart, contract and relax automatically to pump blood, and a person does not need to think about the beat. Valves are named on the same page.
